about: Requests labelled with the kind of work they ask for, for `npm run reflexes -- --kinds` (D773): whether Intuition can tell kinds apart before Auto leans on them. Eight per kind; the other languages hold the same ids.

states.w1: Write a polite email to my landlord asking him to fix the heating.
states.w2: Rewrite this so it sounds friendlier: "Your request has been denied."
states.w3: Draft a short LinkedIn post announcing my new job.
states.w4: Translate this note into Spanish for my neighbour: we're away until Sunday, please water the plants.
states.w5: Write a bedtime story about a fox who is afraid of the dark.
states.w6: Help me write a cover letter for a nursing assistant job.
states.w7: Shorten this to two sentences: I wanted to let you know that Thursday's meeting has moved to Friday at the same time, because several people couldn't come on Thursday.
states.w8: Write a toast for my sister's wedding, funny but kind.
